name: Virtual Cynefin Game (Miro template)
description: Miro board template that replicates Dave Snowden’s Cynefin framework simulation game for remote or hybrid teams, allowing participants to experience the differences between obvious, complicated, complex, and chaotic problem domains through hands-on activities.
reputation: Practical and widely shared Miroverse template for experiential learning of the Cynefin framework in distributed settings.
notes: Facilitator-dependent; focuses on shared understanding and “aha” moments rather than quantitative metrics.
